name: dock
author: CVER Inc.
stores: browser sessionStorage — only for an item with data-open-on-hash or an id, and only once a visitor collapses its panel: the key dc-dock:<name> holding "closed", so an item set to open once per visit stays collapsed for the rest of that tab's visit. Removed when the visitor opens it again. Nothing about the visitor, nothing sent anywhere
without: requires nothing and calls nothing. Without the script the element stays exactly as authored — the documented embed carries `hidden`, so nothing shows; without `hidden` the owner's own markup shows in place, unstyled by this coral.
